description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know the Team The Group Marketplace team manages Grab's marketplaces across Southeast Asia. You will work with team members across multiple departments by marketplace levers such as pricing, incentives, and allocation. The team also generates business insights and proposes data-driven strategic plans to grow the business across both transport and deliveries. Get to Know the Role You will use data-driven insights to create a sustainable, reliable and efficient marketplace for Grab's transport business.
